source_title: Ошибки в ремонте и дизайне интерьера мои топ 7
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 1 trial (Group B design channel, 8 of 37 videos)
notes: Shevrina Round 1 trial 1/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 7. Headline item is a CONTROLLED ON-SITE EXPERIMENT: walls and a joiner-made radiator panel painted to the same NCS article came out visibly different (panel pinker) because paint formulation, substrate and application method all differ - fix is to specify deliberately DIFFERENT shades for a tone-on-tone match. Low promotional ratio, no course pitch.

scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 1 trial (Group B design channel, 8 of 37 videos)
notes: Shevrina Round 1 trial 8/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 8 - the densest single-source lighting addition to Lighting_Design.md so far, with three numeric items. Voltage drop: a reel is 5m and a run exceeding one reel fed from one end is visibly dimmer at the far end - feed from two opposite corners, and give each of several strips its own cable rather than chaining them. Luminous flux is INDEPENDENT of colour temperature - two fixtures of equal lumens at 3000K and 4000K light a tabletop identically; people downgrade to warm because they confuse warm with soft; if 4000K is too bright take 4000K with fewer lumens. Add 1cm to a recessed fixtures stated depth when calculating the ceiling drop. Plus: dont trace a broken perimeter with LED strip; mount a visible strip to throw upward on a corner profile; indicator-lamp switches make spots glow or self-trigger (fix: shunt resistor); size a magnetic track power supply with headroom. Two points also routed to the colour pages: neutral light doesnt distort the flats colours, and the influence of a cornice strip on wall-colour choice is overstated. Medium promotional ratio.

scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 2 (8 of 37 videos; furniture cluster + kitchen + bathroom + hallway + format probe)
notes: Shevrina Round 2 2/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 9 - the dimensional core of the furniture cluster. Zhurnalnyy (low table) <=30-35 cm and large in plan; kofeynyy/pristavnoy ~50 cm+ small top and mobile - two functionally different objects people conflate, and the named failure is one table that is both big and tall. Pairing convention: one bigger-and-lower plus one smaller-and-higher, not a matched set; worked sizing 32 cm high x 90 cm dia plus a 45 cm. Co-scale rule: a small side table suits a ~180-190 cm sofa and reads wrong against a 2400-2500 mm one. Massive-base tables held to 30-35 cm max. Plus the why-a-piece-reads-designed causes list (coaxiality, repetition at scale, deliberate scale contrast, EQUAL CORNER RADII AT EVERY JUNCTION) and contrast of forms as the visual-weight lever (thick base + thin top reads light). Low promotional ratio.

source_title: Стулья для кухни | Как выбрать стул в столовую зону | Дизайн интерьера

Its value is SHARPENING THE LEG RULE past the slogan: the objection is to legs raked in TWO directions at once - nazad bylo by dostatochno. A backward rake alone is fine; the simultaneous sideways splay is the failure. Also: legs must be visually anchored (rake should coincide with the backs angle, coaxially aligned parts) or the chair reads as vinegret iz detaley; junction quality as the tell; bulk vs room size; a cheap light-wood seat glued from offcuts betrays itself and a dark finish hides it; saturated colours lower perceived status; mid-century as the safe thing to mix into minimalism but only with period support. Her own top criterion recorded as-is: if you like the chair its a good chair. Low promotional ratio.

source_title: Дизайн кухни в современных интерьерах: ошибки
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 2 (8 of 37 videos; furniture cluster + kitchen + bathroom + hallway + format probe)
notes: Shevrina Round 2 5/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 13 - THE MOST NUMERICALLY DENSE KITCHEN SOURCE IN THIS VAULT, and the figures cross-check rather than being asserted separately. Dining table to wall 75 cm = 45 (seated) + 30 (passing sideways); to a kitchen run 110 cm = 50 (seated) + 60 (front opening); 145 cm with a dishwasher open plus a non-tucking chair. A dishwasher door occupies a full 80 cm. Measure to the chairs when they dont tuck. Fridge needs a 7-8 cm filler strip or the crisper drawers wont pull out - and the shift can strand an already-installed socket. A radiator within 60 cm of the run blocks the fronts. Stone fabricators require a 10-15 cm hob setback from the edge or they wont warranty the worktop. THIRD DOCUMENTED EXPERIMENT: an overhang WITH a drip groove still fails to keep water off the fronts, extending the Round 1 overhang test. Plus the mechanism behind the push-to-open objection (two motions not one), stainless over acrylic sinks, sockets inside cabinets, and worktop-shadow lighting with 60deg spots vs ~90-110deg diffuse. CONTAINS A RUSSIAN-LAW CLAIM (shaft-vented hoods now illegal) explicitly kept OUT of 16_Legal_and_Regulations per that folders Belarus-only rule. Low promotional ratio.

source_title: Какую плитку выбрать в санузел | Тренды и вечно актуальные виды плиток
pricing_priority: medium (one real RUB range, region unresolved)
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 2 (8 of 37 videos; furniture cluster + kitchen + bathroom + hallway + format probe)
notes: Shevrina Round 2 6/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 11. Deepens the Round 1 tile-format rules with causes and a cost. The dirty-tile effect has three causes - too mottled, too dark, wrong (especially cold) undertone - intensified by pairing with saturated warm wood; plus a fourth physical cause, printed darkened edges making every units border visible. Showroom test: lay 2-3 tiles of the collection side by side and check for edge darkening and whether a continuous texture is achievable. Marble must be MATTE (v prirode ne vstrechayutsya polirovannye materialy), with the small classic format the one place gloss works. Mid formats (20x40, 30x60) are the problem; marble from 120x45 upward. Relief taxonomy (slat/rib timeless; representational, complex-geometric and wave reliefs rejected). Horizontal two-tile wall splits defended as NOT an anti-trend. STANDOUT: a 3 m slab doesnt fit in a lift - hand-carry runs 30,000-50,000 RUB (~$330-$550), avoidable by having the slab cut at the factory to ~1 m pieces with cuts aligned to real design lines. Low promotional ratio.

source_title: Как продумать дизайн ПРИХОЖЕЙ в стиле минимализм | Дизайн интерьера
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 2 (8 of 37 videos; furniture cluster + kitchen + bathroom + hallway + format probe)
notes: Shevrina Round 2 7/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 10. Raise the entrance wardrobe 30-40 cm off the floor (15 cm minimum) - their near-universal technique, with five cumulative reasons: whats underneath is invisible from the flat, low shoes live there, a robot-vacuum dock fits, underfloor heating can dry wet shoes there, and a pouffe can be pushed under. Two caveats: the back panel may not carry the load (ask the joinery shop), and choose the pouffe first. Plus a three-level ladder for lightening the entrance door - flat panel in the wall colour; a contrasting finish ONLY if carried to the ceiling or it reads as a patch; or a second concealed interior door, since on a concealed entrance door only the hinges are hidden. Heating manifolds are the hard engineering case - the raised wardrobe does not hide their feed pipes; recess them, or pass through to the adjacent room and reinforce the opening where you cant lose ~12 cm. CONTAINS A RUSSIAN BTI-DESIGNATION CLAIM about entrance-zone water supply, kept out of 16_Legal_and_Regulations. Also a methodological aside worth keeping: asked how to protect door reveals she questions whether the problem is real, and says dont take internet advice on faith - including mine. Medium promotional ratio.

source_title: Ошибки в дизайне интерьеров | Разбираю интерьеры подписчиков
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 2 (8 of 37 videos; furniture cluster + kitchen + bathroom + hallway + format probe)
notes: Shevrina Round 2 8/8. FULL extraction, fact_yield 9. INCLUDED AS A FORMAT PROBE - the subscriber-critique format was the most substantive one on Anuta Vladys channel - AND IT PASSES: every item is a named problem on a real submitted interior with a specific corrective and a stated reason. Staggered-height pendants named as the most frequent mistake she sees, same for staggered shelves. The over-wide bath alcove: building out only ONE side is the mistake - either build both sides shallower with a full-length horizontal shelf and a dropped ceiling painted the same colour, or build a 60 cm tiled podium larger than the bath with margins at both ends. Paint all three alcove walls one colour. Niches should be thin not massive. Shelf corrective with a dimension: a ~2 cm central vertical divider, fewer and thinner horizontals. Square floor drains rejected on a fabrication ground invisible in a render - the floor must fall to the drain so the tile gets cut heavily including diagonals. Knotty high-contrast wood-look works only on floors not walls. TWO MORE VIDEOS OF THIS FORMAT EXIST (A5G04uPvzL0, p5lXLETWI5s) and are now worth processing. Medium promotional ratio.

source_title: Плохой дизайнер | Как дизайнеры обманывают заказчиков
scope: Shevrina/SMBUREAU Round 3 (8 of 37; selected by format - podcast/mistakes/critique - not by topic)
notes: Shevrina Round 3 1/8. FULL, fact_yield 9. FIRST DESIGNER-VETTING SOURCE IN THIS VAULT. Two kickback schemes: invoice padding at 15-20pct (she calls it fraud, says it is actionable in court, references recent large RU cases) and a concealed discount split (client sees 5-10pct while the designer keeps the rest of a 25pct trade discount). CLIENT-SIDE DEFENCE: never let a designer make purchases through themselves; payment goes client-to-shop directly. Three questions for the first meeting: how are discounts split, what is the payment scheme for services and procurement, is it in the contract. Two competence markers: a designer who publicly recommends paint article numbers is incompetent (SHE IMPLICATES HER OWN PAST SELF and reports repeated sample-pot experiments with no reproduction), and a designer should decline a budget they cant work with rather than render unobtainable furniture and substitute downward. Careful to separate malpractice from legitimate divergence (client-chosen fabricator, post-2022 supply disruption, currency moves) - all three corroborating the Round 2 podcast. NOTE: a designer describing other designers misconduct has an interest; flagged in the note. Litigation claim is RU context, kept out of 16_Legal.

notes: Kuzina Round 1 2/8. FULL, fact_yield 9, promotional_ratio low. Four-method comparison with a stated recommendation (metal threshold). MAKES THE CORK-VS-THRESHOLD FINDING A THREE-CHANNEL CONVERGENCE - Kruglov/Ontario and Shevrina/SMBUREAU already agreed - BUT THE VERDICT IS NOT THE CONTRIBUTION, THE POSITIVE CONDITION IS: cork/sealant/grout are not simply wrong, they are wrong FOR A FLOATING FLOOR, and she uses rigid-joint methods routinely on bonded floors. GENUINELY NEW: the partial-bond trick - where the floor must float, bond only the single row meeting the tile, so the rest moves as designed while the joint row stays stable. Neither existing source addresses this. ALSO NEW: the one geometry that rules thresholds out entirely, a deliberately irregular joint (hexagonal tile interlocking into parquet) where grout is the only option. Liquid cork = sealant plus cork crumb, and at the recommended <=5mm joint width the crumb sometimes will not fit. Plain silicone most elastic and least visible but hardens over time and is easily picked out. Metal threshold works with a floating floor if its cap exceeds ~5mm; ITS REAL OBSTACLE IS PROCUREMENT - cannot be bought with the tile or the parquet, must be separately sourced and delivered, the item most likely to be missing on site. SEPARATELY SUPPLIES BUILD-UP FIGURES: tile+adhesive ~15mm vs parquet+plywood+adhesive ~30-32mm, putting numbers on Petrishin-Stroys qualitative thickness-direction asymmetry, and explaining why the screed cannot be set before the finish on both sides is chosen. notes: Kuzina Round 1 4/8. Planning order tasks -> constraints -> furniture. ARGUES FOR WALK-THROUGH ROOMS against universal client resistance (a corridor in a 100m2 flat eats ~15m2, a whole rooms worth), attributing resistance to residual fear of Soviet uplotnenie. ROOM SHAPE CANNOT BE FIXED WITH FINISHES; advises against fully asymmetric layouts because MORE OPTIONS IS NOT FREEDOM, IT IS MORE CHOICES, AND IT ENDS IN WORSE WORK. DIAGNOSTIC FOR AN UNFIXABLE PLAN: circulation zone 14m2 against childrens rooms of 14 and 11 - larger AND better-proportioned than either habitable room. source_title: Натуральное дерево в ванной комнате: как используется, какие плюсы и минусы, особенности и советы
notes: Kuzina Round 1 5/8. FULL, fact_yield 19, promotional_ratio low. THIS VAULTS FIRST SOURCE ON WOOD IN A WET ROOM and the most technically substantive of Round 1 after the two long lectures - unusually for this channel a MATERIALS source, framed sceptically rather than aspirationally. Two preconditions: good ventilation and impregnated wood; DISTANCE FROM WET ZONES IS A PLANNING-STAGE DECISION, with the explicit warning that dry zones still suffer condensate. SPECIES RANKED WITH REASONS NOT PREFERENCES: oak best BECAUSE IT CONTAINS TANNIN, a natural antiseptic inhibiting fungal growth, not merely because it is dense; BEECH IS POPULAR FOR FURNITURE AND MUST NOT GO IN A BATHROOM (bows and opens along glue lines, or cracks); ash harder than some oaks but blotchy so usually toned; larch the cheap option that works with proper anti-rot impregnation; BIRCH A SCOPED EXCEPTION - it cracks fast, a defect everywhere except a wabi-sabi bathroom where it is the point. TWO DEFORMATION MECHANISMS WITH RULES: general movement (never fix a large flat surface rigidly; A WORKED FAILURE WHERE JOINERY BUILT TIGHT AROUND A WASHING MACHINE BOTH CANNOT EXPAND AND IS SHAKEN LOOSE BY VIBRATION; framed fronts beat solid panels; SHELVES NEAR WATER ARE A MAINTENANCE TRAP NOT A MATERIAL FAILURE since a worktop wipes easily and a shelf means unloading everything), and CUPPING ALONG THE GROWTH RINGS which bows a single large piece even if well dried - REMEDIED BY NARROW LAMELLAE, 5-9cm WIDE. CENTRAL PRESCRIPTION IS OIL OVER LACQUER, ARGUED BY MECHANISM: lacquer is a film protecting only while hermetic, and once cracked lets in moisture that CANNOT EVAPORATE BACK OUT, which is where rot starts; yacht lacquer no exception and also yellows; enamel scratches; stain needs lacquer over it and shows every chip; OIL FILLS THE PORES SO THERE IS NO ROOM FOR MOISTURE, lets any that enters evaporate back out, and repairs by sanding and re-oiling. WOODEN BASINS REJECTED OUTRIGHT - worse than garden gnomes, and uncoated ones last a couple of weeks and go slimy - with the rule choose ceramic for sanitaryware. BARN BOARD CAUTION: often too warped for even a purpose-cut basin recess, deep cracks collect dirt that cannot be cleaned out. SMALL WOODEN ITEMS TOLERATE HUMIDITY FAR BETTER THAN LARGE ONES. ASR moderate; the lamellae sentence partially truncated but the 5-9cm figure clear. No prices.

source_title: Что делать, если у вас низкий потолок и как сделать его визуально выше
notes: Kuzina Round 2 3/8. FULL, fact_yield 31, promotional_ratio low. THE STRONGEST SOURCE OF ROUND 2 BY A WIDE MARGIN and one of the densest single-problem sources on the channel. THE PROBLEM IS LARGELY SELF-INFLICTED AND SHE QUANTIFIES IT: highest new-build ceiling she has heard of is 320cm, OF WHICH ~20cm GOES TO SCREED AND PLASTERBOARD, so 3.20 becomes 2.90 or less. THREE CEILING-VOID FIGURES THAT DECIDE THE LIGHTING STRATEGY: recessed fixtures cost a MINIMUM 8cm, plasterboard without them ~5cm, a good stretch ceiling (Clipso) ~3cm. WHITE DOES NOT MAKE A CEILING READ HIGHEST - a misconception; the highest-reading ceiling is painted THE WALL COLOUR, HALF A TONE TO A TONE LIGHTER, because the ceiling sits in shadow while walls are lit. Semi-gloss PAINT yes; a GLOSSY STRETCH CEILING no (looks like plastic) - matte only. Glossy floors also raise the perceived ceiling. THE GOVERNING PRINCIPLE: the eye must not locate the wall/ceiling line, because that line defines the walls height - hence a radius via cornice or plaster. AND THE CONSEQUENCE PEOPLE GET WRONG: with a radius you CANNOT paint wall and ceiling different colours, because that re-establishes the line. Cornice geometry: more onto the ceiling than the wall (low height, large depth), and some cornices can be INVERTED. Never below 5cm; if a proper cornice will not fit, fit none. COVE LIGHTING IS SELF-DEFEATING - A SECOND INDEPENDENT OBJECTION TO A DETAIL KRUGLOV ALREADY CAUTIONS AGAINST ON DUST GROUNDS: it needs >=5cm to the ceiling for light to escape SO IT ILLUMINATES EXACTLY THE JUNCTION YOU WERE HIDING; fix by putting a light moulding UNDER the cornice. Drop the chandelier entirely and use technical light; tracks fit any style including classical; ALWAYS SPECIFY A DIFFUSER because strip and corner joints show. THE COUNTER-INTUITIVE FURNITURE RULE: what matters is the proportion between furniture height and the wall strip above, AND HALF-AND-HALF IS THE WORST CASE - and DO NOT use low furniture in a SMALL room (a low ceiling is not a small room; low furniture there reads like cropped trousers, with Frank Lloyd Wrights Prairie House as the deliberate contrast). source_title: 10 Правил как сочетать деревянные отделки в интерьере

She also RELATIVISES HER OWN RULE OF THREE, presenting a designer working with five to seven finishes as a signature and calling it beautiful - THE COUNT IS A HEURISTIC, THE STRUCTURE AND UNDERTONE DISCIPLINE ARE THE REQUIREMENTS. source_title: Как сочетать металлические отделки в интерьере | Интерьерные тренды
notes: Kuzina Round 2 5/8. FULL, fact_yield 21, promotional_ratio low. NOTHING ELSE IN THIS VAULT COVERS METAL-FINISH COORDINATION AT ALL. She states OUTRIGHT that the rules are induced from photographs of real interiors BECAUSE THE INFORMATION IS NOT IN THE LITERATURE - treat as one practitioners systematisation, and that disclosure is unusual enough to be worth recording. THE OPENING IS THE MOST USEFUL PART BECAUSE IT SHOWS HOW THE PROBLEM ACTUALLY ARISES - A PROCUREMENT CASCADE, NOT A DESIGN DECISION: gold pendant bought before the kitchen -> gold-profile facades to match -> no gold in standard hardware so buy gold handles -> BUT THE BUILT-IN APPLIANCES HAVE SILVER HANDLES AND GOLD-HANDLED BUILT-INS ARE VERY HARD TO SOURCE, so settle for black -> then a mixer roughly matching. ASSEMBLED, THE GOLD PENDANT READS ALMOST SILVER IN DAYLIGHT AND NOTHING MATCHES. And the obvious fix - chrome everything and leave the pendant - READS AS A RANDOM SET. HIERARCHY IS THE ANSWER WITH FIGURES: the dominant metal takes ~70 percent, AND HER CONTRAST PAIR PROVES THE THRESHOLD - a bathroom with ONLY TWO METALS at ~60/40 STILL FAILS because near-half-and-half has no dominant, against a success at 70-80 percent in one family with a rose-gold accent at 20-30. TWO METALS IN A SMALL ROOM, UP TO FOUR IN A LARGE ONE - THE REASON IS OBJECT COUNT, since a small room has too few objects for each not to carry its own finish. METALS COMBINE WHEN THEY ARE DIFFERENT: warm+cold, glossy+matte, or ANYTHING PLUS BLACK. TWO SIMILAR COLOURS FAIL and worst in cold metals - silver+nickel, silver+chrome, chrome+nickel will fail IF THEY SHARE A SURFACE TREATMENT, which is why two chromes clash. NAMING IS UNRELIABLE BETWEEN SUPPLIERS: a maker with brass but no gold will label the brass gold, and brass is often sold as champagne - so the spec-sheet name does not identify the finish. The mix includes ANYTHING with metallic sheen (textiles, sheen wallpaper, rust-imitating tile). Distribution: spread the dominant evenly; distribute by height (A RULE SHE HERSELF DOUBTS, noting most examples did not follow it); and give objects in different finishes something in common - A CHANDELIER CONTAINING SEVERAL FINISHES TIES GOLD AND SILVER SIDE TABLES TOGETHER. ASR poor.

source_title: Как использовать дверь в интерьере: дверь как арт-объект или обычная дверь?
notes: Kuzina Round 2 6/8. FULL, fact_yield 17, promotional_ratio low. ROUGHLY THE FIRST 40 PERCENT IS A HISTORICAL PREAMBLE on prehistoric doors AND WAS DELIBERATELY NOT EXTRACTED, consistent with how the ornament seminars art-history section was handled; yield is against the back half only. TWO THESES: on a small budget choose NEUTRAL doors OR make an ART OBJECT of them, NOTHING IN BETWEEN (a half-decorated door is the failure case); and A DOOR NEVER PLAYS THE LEADING ROLE - the reason being PHYSICAL rather than aesthetic, that THE DOOR IS BEHIND YOU ONCE YOU HAVE ENTERED. If you complicate the door, complicate the interior. Her analogies set the ceiling on ambition: the background landscape in a Renaissance painting (Leonardos are worth examining but you look at the figures first), and THEATRE SCENERY THAT DOES NOT REPLACE THE ACTORS. THE STRONGEST PRACTICAL ARGUMENT: A DECORATED DOOR FORCES MATCHING COMMITMENTS ACROSS THE WHOLE FLAT - diagonal veneer plus routed slots needs diagonal parquet or supporting wall battens; A DOOR WITH HEXAGONS IS THE WORST CASE because you must repeat hexagons in every room or accept different doors on each side of the opening. THE EDGE-COLOUR PROCEDURE, EASY TO APPLY: stand in the room and pull the door toward you - the colour that then appears is the OUTSIDE faces colour, AND THAT IS THE EDGE COLOUR. Plus: DOBORY AND ARCHITRAVE EDGES CAN BE A CONTRASTING COLOUR UNRELATED TO THE LEAF (her black dobory running into a black skirting give fine graphic definition without much black); TREAT A DOOR AS PART OF THE WALL TO HIDE A BADLY PLACED ONE; in symmetrical arrangements ONE OF THE PAIR IS OFTEN A FALSE DOOR; bi-folds where an open leaf would obstruct a rooms shape; and DOORS NEED NOT ALL MATCH - her own hallway has three with three architrave treatments - BUT HIERARCHY MUST BE LOGICAL (big sliding glass to a bedroom while the living room gets a small ordinary door is a WORSE error than mixed architraves in one room). source_title: Квартира неправильной формы: как исправить геометрию

source_title: Как сделать комнату светлее
notes: Kuzina Round 3 3/7. FULL, fact_yield 20, promotional_ratio low. STRUCTURALLY THE TWIN OF E6nYBdz9NhM - she delivers the standard advice competently, marks where it ends, then asks whether following it produces an interior anyone wants, and LEAVES THE QUESTION GENUINELY OPEN. source_title: Как организовать рабочее место дома
notes: Kuzina Round 3 4/7. FULL, fact_yield 16, promotional_ratio NONE. Scoped to a work area INSIDE a bedroom or living room, not a separate study; April 2020, first weeks of pandemic home-working. A zone exists only when the SPACE is treated - dropped ceiling, dedicated fittings, a fragment of screening wall, or a different wall material. Prompted by clients wanting a 13 m2 children's room zoned four ways - i tak ne byvaet. CONSEQUENCE: any plan labelling zones should be audited against this test; if only furniture placement changes the zone is notional and the drawing is overclaiming. It IS needed for negotiation, video calls, high concentration, and for people who cannot get into work mode at home. WHOEVER SITS IN THE THROUGH-ROUTE GETS INTERRUPTED - her own lived case, and the passer-by sees your screen, which is the other half. Fix: sit side-on, or a corner desk. OPEN-THROUGH SHELVING PASSES LIGHT BUT BLOCKS NO SOUND AT ALL - light-passing separation is never acoustic separation, the same trade-off as glass partitions in gwa1wsTYYLE. source_title: Спа дома: как сделать ванную комнату местом отдыха
notes: Kuzina Round 3 5/7. FULL, fact_yield 29 - THE HIGHEST-YIELD SOURCE OF ROUND 3. HARD GATE: barefoot use of porcelain or stone requires a heated floor - cold floor and vy ne v spa, a prosto v sanuzle. Underfloor heating is a PRECONDITION here, not an upgrade. TRANSFERABLE TECHNIQUE: tactile contrast including on surfaces nobody touches - the perceived smoothness of the bath comes from the roughness around it; pebble surfacing BEHIND the bath rather than underfoot is the sharpest example. STEAM-ROOM TABLE where humidity, temperature and ventilation obligation line up: IR cabin (no steam, 60C, safest), Finnish sauna (15%, 100C, natural ventilation may suffice), hammam (100%, 45-65C, FORCED VENTILATION AND NATURAL SUPPLY MANDATORY); failure mode is smell, fungus or mould. Cedar releases essential oils on heating; timber unsuitable for a hammam. RUSSIAN REGULATORY BLOCK - factory-assembled units only, no collective-use saunas or wood-fired stoves, brick/monolithic with RC slabs only, max 2 m2 taken from bathroom or corridor, housing/fire/sanitary approvals with the set differing by city, and she flags her own uncertainty about Rospotrebnadzor. ROUTED TO THE BATHROOM PAGE WITH THE JURISDICTION FLAGGED INLINE, NOT TO 16_Legal_and_Regulations WHICH IS BELARUS-ONLY. Fittings ladder from whirlpool baths (MUST BE USED WEEKLY or the system degrades) down to a multi-mode shower head (many heads mix water with air, and differently - she rates Hansgrohe Raindance) and a foot bath. DIM-TO-WARM named as the lighting feature to specify, plus a finish constraint - if RGB is planned specify cream walls and grey floors. SHE REBUTS THE STANDARD STYLING ADVICE: open shelves and stacked towels work in a salon because staff re-fold them all day. Closes on the design move - vy povyshaete status vannoy ot obyknovennogo sanuzla do komnaty. source_title: Что взять с собой из старой квартиры
notes: Kuzina Round 3 6/7. FULL, fact_yield 22, promotional_ratio NONE. THREE-QUESTION METHOD in ascending order of validity: emotional attachment (TEST: put it out of sight, if a week later you have not remembered it, discard it), SUNK COST - her live case of two identical Italian pendants that do not suit the new flat but were expensive, which she calls povod dlya razmyshleniy, NOT a reason - and the only argument she endorses, that it genuinely fits including by size. DE-ANCHORING TEST: imagine seeing the object for the first time, not knowing who gave it to you. MECHANISM BEHIND SOUVENIR FAILURE: many small disparate objects do not form a rhythm, they form noise; you merely resign yourself to their existing where you put them - whereas many HOMOGENEOUS objects work. Conversation pieces excepted (Philippe Starck squeezer as the type). PICTURES ARE THE CATEGORY SHE CALLS A DISASTER - do not bring what does not suit unless committing to eclecticism from the start, what suited an interior you are demolishing, or the largest category, pictures that suit nothing anywhere, which clients disproportionately own and arrive wanting to build the scheme around. Do bring abstract work at least 1 m on a side in a good frame - THE FRAME TIES AN ORDINARY PICTURE TO THE INTERIOR AND MAKES IT READ AS MORE EXPENSIVE, and it is a separate cost line. NEVER REPRODUCTIONS OF FAMOUS PAINTINGS - the same phenomenon as the bears in the pine forest, only now it is an abstract woman and it is a Matisse. THE PROPORTIONALITY RULE, THE MOST TRANSFERABLE LINE: the constraint an object imposes on the plan should be proportional to its value - a 2,000 RUB (~$30) reproduction dictating which pier gets the cabinet fails it; rare posters/etchings at ~10,000 RUB (~$150) plus framing pass, because esteticheskaya tsennost bolshe chem denezhnaya stoimost. FULL, fact_yield 30, NET 29 - THE LEAST REDUNDANT SOURCE IN ROUND 5, because the organising concept is new to this vault. promotional_ratio low, AND AS THE ONLY 2024 UPLOAD PROCESSED IT IS A USEFUL MIDPOINT FOR THE CHANNEL-FORMAT OBSERVATION: light closing pitch, NO Telegram funnel, unlike both 2026 uploads. The problem it names: a space can look chaotic and unorganised even with good furniture forms and a successful colour scheme, and the reason is the absence of a focal point. THE DEFINITION AND ITS CONSTRAINT: a focal point is set by the designer OR by the ARCHITECT (bay window, niche, projection, window, staircase), and where the architecture already sets one the designer's job is to SUPPORT it, not contradict it. PLACEMENT RESTS ON ONE GEOMETRIC FACT: we look most easily at what is parallel to our face, so a focal point usually carries a vertical component - but it can sit on the FLOOR (entrance groups) or the CEILING (sleeping zones). TWO APPROACHES, and the better is the delicate one where the focal point sets the style and everything else supports it - her worked example has a chandelier echoing the wreath in a photograph, chair upholstery echoing the dress edging, ceiling moulding echoing the implied classicism. SUPPORT IS NOT COLOUR-MATCHING; IT IS REPEATING FORMS AND REFERENCES. THE ONE DIMENSION: art above a sofa must be at least half the sofa's length, better two-thirds, and if not, make up the distance with sconces or side lamps. Plus: an accent wall is not always self-sufficient and wants a focal point against it; highlighting a large object makes it read larger, so keep a wardrobe neutral and brighten its interior instead; a non-vertical object needs accessories or fittings above to become a readable GROUP; the bedroom split (large room accent the whole bed, small room accent the headboard and strip the horizontal surface); a pendant must be judged in both day and evening states; and the multi-focus rules - one per zone agreeing in style and meaning, never two side by side in one plane, the eyes need a pause and a focal point must breathe, and one must dominate while the other supports. A DEDICATED PAGE WAS WARRANTED ON CONTENT BUT WITHHELD AS single-account, logged in Pending_Wiki_Page_Decisions.md. ASR good to moderate; three fitting-range names deliberately not guessed.

source_title: Как улучшить любой интерьер
notes: Kuzina Round 5 6/8. FULL, fact_yield 16, NET OF RESTATEMENT ONLY 11 - THE LOWEST NET YIELD AND THE LOWEST RATIO (69%) OF ANY SOURCE ACROSS FIVE ROUNDS. THIS IS PRECISELY THE FAILURE MODE ROUND 5'S DISPATCH NOTE PREDICTED FOR CLUSTER 3: not a low fact count, but facts new to the page they land on and not new to the vault. Five items substantially restate held material - the verb-list functionality questions, the minimum-three-light-sources rule, the art-selection parameters, and the mix-don't-match rule. Recorded plainly rather than counted as coverage, AND TWO OF THE RESTATED ITEMS WERE DELIBERATELY NOT ROUTED, with that decision noted in the extraction note so a later reader does not assume they were missed. Its genuine value is concentrated in four items. THE RUG RULES: no rug is acceptable in a small bedroom but leaves a living room incomplete; refusing one means devising other floor zoning, which is always harder to execute than laying a rug; too-small rugs spoil proportion and shrink the room; and correct rug SIZE matters more for the design than its colour or pattern. THE GLASS TEST: it is considered good form that every seat has a surface beside it for a glass - a single checkable test for any seating layout - with the bedroom variant of a surface behind the headboard where no nightstand fits. THE SOMETHING-LIVING OBSERVATION, which explains a convention rather than repeating it: published interiors always contain plants because plants remove the feeling of abandonment on a shoot and behave better on camera than dogs or cats, but they look just as good in the interior without the photograph. AND SOMETHING OLD: traces of time put a soul into a new interior, and it is what separates two stylistically similar rooms where one catches the eye and the other does not. Plus gloss on matte walls giving highlights and two different registers, and the conditional that a poster or photograph needs handmade objects around it in a way an original does not. ASR poor to moderate. No prices.

source_title: Почему дорогие интерьеры цветные, а бюджетные бежевые
notes: Kuzina Round 5 7/8. FULL, fact_yield 19, net 17. PROMOTIONAL_RATIO MEDIUM - THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE 2026 UPLOAD WITH A TELEGRAM FUNNEL, WHICH CONFIRMS THE ROUND 4 CHANNEL-FORMAT OBSERVATION AS A PATTERN rather than a one-off. Telegram plugged at the start with a QR code and again at the close, with materials for the video withheld to it. THE MOST STRUCTURALLY-ARGUED SOURCE FROM THIS CHANNEL: it explains a design outcome by the economics of how the products are sold, not by taste or skill. AND IT CONTAINS THE BEST STEELMAN OF THE NEUTRAL DEFAULT ANYWHERE IN THIS VAULT, from the practitioner who has attacked it four times: someone assembling an interior themselves is primarily REDUCING RISK, and a neutral palette seems safe precisely because it is harder to spoil, assembles in parts more easily, and depends less on perfect shade matching. THIS IDENTIFIES THE VARIABLE THE WHOLE DISPUTE TURNS ON AND MAKES IT RESOLVABLE: neutral is the right answer for an interior assembled INCREMENTALLY BY A NON-EXPERT, which is a different question from whether it is right aesthetically. Both her positions are correct, about different situations. Other items: white kitchen fronts at roughly 40-45% of mass-market choice for years (research house NOT recoverable from the ASR, treated as her reported figure); bright colour exists on the shop floor to stop the gaze - the attention economy - with a cited but unrecoverable claim that up to 90% of first impression is colour, flagged as a widely-circulated figure of contested provenance; THE STRUCTURAL REASON COMPLEX COLOUR IS NOT SOLD IN SHOPPING CENTRES - it is inconvenient to sell: hard to show quickly, hard to explain if the salesperson is not a colour expert, and it requires accounting for colours of products the company does not sell; THE MISSING MIDDLE - no warm smoky greys, olives, garnets or wines, because complex shades produce no instant effect and do not reveal themselves in a small sample, so on a stand they look dirty and dusty; the Josef Albers attribution for the relativity principle the vault held unsourced; AND THE PUNCHLINE FIGURE: a non-standard enamel colour raises a facade's cost by 10, at most 20 percent - so the difference sometimes begins with one person choosing between six ready facades and another between a hundred complex shades. A CHOICE-SET GAP BEFORE IT IS A BUDGET GAP. ASR good (scripted 2026 upload) but both external citations destroyed. No currency figures.

source_title: Колор блок
notes: Kuzina Round 5 8/8. FULL, fact_yield 26, net 25, promotional_ratio none. PROMOTED OUT OF ROUND 4'S DEFERRAL LIST, where it had been set aside as a likely overlap with lptrnXyf0as; the Round 4 close-out judged the overlap probably did not exist, and it does not - they share one cross-reference she makes herself and are otherwise different techniques. SHE REJECTS THE STANDARD DEFINITION (combining complementary colours) as arbitrary, since any colours can be combined, and supplies her own with all three parameters required: large colour patches; contrast BY COLOUR, the simplest of Itten's seven contrasts; and plane matters more than volume. AND IT CONTAINS A SCOPED REVERSAL OF A RULE THIS VAULT HOLDS: in colour block it is better to use three bright patches than eight colours in small elements, and elements of one colour are grouped TOGETHER - there is no task of smearing or distributing colour around the interior. COLOUR SUPPORT DISTRIBUTES AN ACCENT; COLOUR BLOCK CONSOLIDATES IT. Different techniques with opposite rules, recorded as such rather than filed alongside. THE OPERATIONAL TEST that distinguishes it from merely bright walls: two interiors with bright emerald walls, one lacking colour contrast (green plus bright metal) and therefore just bright plain walls, the other with green walls, YELLOW floor and blue chairs and reading flatter - that is colour block. Plus THE THREE WEAKNESSES: it takes all the attention so becomes the only technique the interior rests on; it leaves no place for small detail; and it often fragments a room. A STAGED ADOPTION PATH (transit zones, then bathrooms, then bedrooms) WITH AN EXPLICIT WARNING THAT SMALL BRIGHT OBJECTS DO NOT PREDICT HOW YOU WILL FEEL ABOUT LARGE ONES - the cheap test is not a scaled-down version of the real one. Coloured outlines as the low-commitment version. THE FOUR CASES WHERE FLAT PAINTED SHAPES ARE JUSTIFIED, and the failure where painted rectangles meet mouldings - a stereoscopic model where one eye sees mouldings and the other colour patches. Primaries give the strongest contrast, declining off the wheel's centre. And the gradient at which colour block becomes wall painting: recognisable forms end it. A SUBSTANTIAL DE STIJL / BAUHAUS LINEAGE ARGUMENT (that it reached interiors via Mondrian to Bauhaus rather than via Saint Laurent, with van Doesburg, Rietveld, Malevich, El Lissitzky, Le Corbusier and Perriand) WAS DELIBERATELY NOT ROUTED as art history, per this vault's standing deprioritisation; only Alvar Aalto's 1929 hospital was kept, as the one case tying the technique to a stated purpose. ASR moderate but proper nouns badly hit; two attributions flagged as unsafe. No prices.

source_title: Состав дизайн-проекта. Какие чертежи входят в дизайн-проект
scope: Mikhailovskaya course playlist - shortlist video 1 of 3 (22 of 26 rejected at triage)
notes: Mikhailovskaya mini-round 1/3. FULL, fact_yield 27, net 25, promotional_ratio low. THE ONLY MANUALLY-CAPTIONED SOURCE IN THIS VAULT (generated=False) - transcript quality far above any auto-generated Russian source processed here. Promotional criterion applied per the Kuzina 2026 precedent: she directs viewers to her own Revit and 3ds Max tutorials but NOTHING IS WITHHELD to that funnel, so a pitch that FOLLOWS complete content is low, where a pitch that REPLACES content is medium. A SECOND INDEPENDENT CHANNEL ON DESIGNER SCOPE OF SERVICE, supplying what Kuzina's H43m5bn7W8k lacked - that source gives the STAGES of a design project, this gives the DELIVERABLES sheet by sheet, which is what lets a client hold a proposal up against something. THREE TIERS: eskizny (visualisation explicitly without reference to reality, appropriate when either side is unsure or the client needs only the idea); standard package (the minimum that can be built from, with real materials plus obligatory specifications and counts); full (plus 3D views of contentious junctions - furniture-to-wall, a special panel - drawn so furniture makers and builders do not make mistakes, i.e. a DEFECT-PREVENTION DEVICE FOR THE TRADES, not a sales image). Then a 19-sheet list from title page to specifications. FIVE ITEMS A CLIENT WOULD NOT KNOW TO ASK FOR, each with a stated reason: TILE SETTING-OUT IS THE DESIGNER'S OBLIGATION and belongs on BOTH the floor plan and the elevations because the tiler works from the elevations; UNDERFLOOR HEATING needs zone AREAS stated for purchasing, wall offsets drawn, nothing under furniture or appliances, and client agreement; SEPARATE BLACK-AND-WHITE ELECTRICAL ELEVATIONS, which she says she has not seen others do, because sockets end up behind furniture and a ceiling outlet is easy to miss; LABEL EVERY OUTLET including ones no switch controls, because an unlabelled outlet is ambiguous between deliberately-unswitched and forgotten; and elevations should label the MECHANISM not just the object. ALSO a detail that lands on Kuzina Round 5's finished-floor finding: her project goes 2800 to 2650 mm after floor levelling, carried explicitly from survey plan to post-replanning plan - the DOCUMENTATION CONTROL for the error that source identified. AUDIENCE NOTE: this is designer-facing material, which this vault normally rejects; it survives because a walkthrough of what a designer DELIVERS is simultaneously a checklist of what a client should DEMAND. No prices.

source_title: Ванная. Все про планировку и сантехнику. ЧАСТЬ 1
scope: Mikhailovskaya course playlist - shortlist video 2 of 3 (22 of 26 rejected at triage)
notes: Mikhailovskaya mini-round 2/3. FULL, fact_yield 42, net 38, promotional_ratio NONE across 61 minutes. THE STRONGEST DIMENSIONAL SOURCE ROUTED TO THIS VAULT'S BATHROOM PAGES, because she plans THREE REAL BATHROOMS LIVE ON SCREEN - placing blocks, measuring gaps and REJECTING arrangements when the numbers fail - so the dimensions are constraints that killed specific layouts rather than a table of minimums. METHOD: locate the sewer riser first, because the WC is the first thing placed and cannot move; rough blocks before any detail; start from the BATH where there is one; and a bathroom needing replanning is NOT a local decision, the layout must be developed in complex with the whole flat. WORKING DIMENSIONS: vanity depth 550-600 (she uses 600); built-in washing machine 600, free-standing 650-680 because of clearances and servicing; SHOWER ENTRY 600 MINIMUM - at 660 she only just passes and 540 is impossible; boiler ~400x500; shower enclosure 900x900 minimum; bath 1600 minimum to bathe adequately; partition ~50 plus tile ~100. THE SETTING-OUT TRAP THAT KILLED A LAYOUT: count the adhesive AND the tile when sizing a partition - she needed 650 clear and had 601. CONSTRAINTS: a boiler cannot hang on a non-load-bearing wall without a welded steel frame, which must be entered in the project; a glass panel enclosing an unreachable gap collects dust and condensate and cannot be wiped; a stationary TILED partition rather than glass between a shower and free-standing machines - though glass reads semi-transparent and so eats less space than a solid unit. BATH MATERIALS: steel cheapest, acrylic mid, cast iron dearest, and acrylic is her universal recommendation. MIXERS ARE THE STRONGEST SECTION: spout length is the governing parameter and must project beyond the rim or water pours onto it; A RIM MIXER FITS ACRYLIC WITHOUT DIFFICULTY AND MAY NOT FIT OTHER BATH MATERIALS, so the mixer choice effectively decides the bath material; check the mixer's widest part against the rim and phone the supplier because drawings often omit it; floor-standing mixers are decorative and wrong for 90% of homes; specify a spout even on a shower-only mixer, at least to fill a bath for a child; round over square for maintenance. FLUSH FLOOR-LEVEL SHOWERS: beautiful in a picture and maximally impractical in life - minimum 2 cm fall, better to sink the tray, and in a flat make a threshold. A SECOND INDEPENDENT ARGUMENT FOR A THRESHOLD, from drainage and serviceability, where Kuzina's comes from leak-sensor shutoff timing. Trap selection by capacity AND width. AND A PROGRAMME DECISION: a shower cabin is not a bath - fit even a small sit-bath if possible, because a bath's relevance rises sharply with children, and warning the client is framed as an obligation. No prices.

source_title: Ванная. ЧАСТЬ 2. Как выбрать умывальник, унитаз, смесители
scope: Mikhailovskaya course playlist - shortlist video 3 of 3 (22 of 26 rejected at triage)
notes: Mikhailovskaya mini-round 3/3. FULL, fact_yield 45, NET 42 - THE HIGHEST SINGLE-SOURCE YIELD IN THIS VAULT. promotional_ratio low (closing subscribe request only). THE STRONGER HALF OF THE BATHROOM PAIR, because it carries the COUPLINGS that decide a layout - chains where choosing one component silently forecloses another. THE BEST ITEM, AND IT FOLLOWS ARITHMETICALLY RATHER THAN BEING ASSERTED: a vessel basin and an under-worktop washing machine are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. The standard is 850 mm from finished floor to the basin's TOP EDGE; a vessel bowl ~100 high puts the worktop at ~750; a washing machine is 860-870 high and will not go under it; putting a vessel basin over a machine-height worktop puts the rim at 950-960. So THE BASIN TYPE IS DICTATED BY THE PLAN, NOT BY TASTE. Basin type also decides the worktop material (an undermount basin is GLUED, so no chipboard and better no timber) AND the drawer layout (with an inset basin the bowl and trap occupy the cabinet, so a full-width drawer beneath CANNOT EXIST - she demonstrates the impossibility on a real rendering). BASIN MIXERS: spout length again, worked - a shallow basin at 350 set 150 off the wall against a 100 spout pours water BEHIND the basin; 20 mm maximum from basin edge to worktop edge, ideally flush; some basins arrive with a tap hole and so cannot take a wall mixer; therefore choose basin and mixer TOGETHER. WC AND FRAME: right angles in the drain run risk poor drainage; rimless is more hygienic; the frame is chosen TO SUIT the pan, with 18 cm depth as the safe project allowance and compatibility set by the fixing studs; AND THE SEQUENCING FACT - the frame mounts on the CONCRETE floor before screed and tiling, so the WC type is a PLANNING-stage decision. A COUPLING: a tile-insert flush button requires the installation to be faced IN TILE; clad it in MDF or HPL and you must use a surface-mounted button. HYGIENIC SHOWER: one-point versus two-point is a PLANNING decision because two-point needs more wall space - her worked case has 850 where 900 would be better, so one-point. WASHER/DRYER: built-in cabinet ~600x600, free-standing ~700; a dryer stacks via a SPECIAL MOUNTING KIT, not through a chipboard shelf. STORAGE, on which she is emphatic - you can choose the sanitaryware brilliantly and fail entirely by not providing storage - cupboard above the installation by default at 400 mm projection, storage behind the mirror where short, and a reach check showing 800-1700 is beyond a short person. ACCESS FOR SERVICING, A GENUINE GAP IN THIS VAULT: provide trap access by hatch, removable tile or through a cabinet, pre-empting the modern-traps-clean-from-outside objection; DRAW THE HATCH ON THE VISUALISATION so the client understands there will be a seam and a square; a free-standing bath cannot have one; and locate meters at survey. CLOSES WITH A 'BEAUTIFUL BUT UNREALISABLE' GALLERY reading a dozen real renderings - free-standing baths that cannot be cleaned behind, podiums too narrow to stand on safely, mirrors too high to wash, timber vanities in wet rooms, screens with no room to open - and the client-management rule: warn them about basin height, and if they accept it they sign off on it. No prices.

source_title: Обои в интерьере - устарело или нет? Какие обои можно использовать
scope: Mikhailovskaya course playlist - shortlist video 4 of 4 (the unverified item, now processed)
notes: Mikhailovskaya shortlist 4/4. FULL, fact_yield 21, net 19, promotional_ratio low. THE UNVERIFIED FOURTH SHORTLIST ITEM, now processed - and narrower than the bathroom pair exactly as flagged at triage: one strong organising idea plus pattern rules and three justifications. Her position is neither advocacy nor refusal - she uses wallpaper but sparingly and only when justified. ITS MOST VALUABLE CONTRIBUTION IS AN UNRESOLVED CONTRADICTION IT CREATES: she gives 'cracks do not show through wallpaper' as the FIRST of her three justifications, and this vault already records Shevrina stating flatly the opposite - wallpaper does not hide cracks, it accentuates them, with a mechanism and with reinforcing mesh dismissed as a plaster over a hole in asphalt. RECORDED AS A PERSPECTIVES BLOCK rather than folded into either side, because it is a PHYSICAL CHECKABLE claim - unusual in this vault, where most disagreements are matters of judgment - and because the case for wallpaper over paint in a new build rests substantially on it. Shevrina's side is currently better supported (she states a mechanism and backs the adjacent restorability claim with a worked case from her own flat) and this should be settled by a third source rather than by weighing assertions. THE ORGANISING IDEA: wallpaper must not imitate what it cannot imitate, and the mechanism is TACTILE - brick, stone, tile, board and textured concrete are hard relief materials known by touch, wallpaper is smooth, and the dissonance between what is seen and what is felt is what reads as fake. PLUS THE RENDER TRAP, which explains why it keeps being specified: it can look good on a visualisation and never in the interior, so the failure mode is invisible in exactly the medium the decision is made in. Gloss compounds it. HER TEST, the transferable part: ask the wallpaper what it claims to imitate and take it only if the answer matches what you see and feel - worked across five samples, accepting a stamped-gold paint imitation and a painted fish panel, rejecting board, hard weave and stone. THREE LEGITIMATE JUSTIFICATIONS, all non-visual: technical/budget with a real ALLOCATION argument (save on walls to fund furniture, moving the spend to where it shows more); style (Art Deco, classic, contemporary classic, Provence - where silk or fabric coverings are characteristic elements OF the style, and it need not be cheap); and function - the children's-room case where the material's WEAKNESS is the argument for it, since paper wallpaper is ecological, carries atmosphere and is easily damaged and easily replaced, WITH THE CAVEAT that this applies to paper and not to non-woven. PATTERN: the repeat should be as large as possible, and the checkable test is that a pattern repeating twice within one roll width reads as a template; wider rolls are better for seams but a narrow roll demands a larger repeat, and the two compound. Paintable wallpaper is 'super treacherous' and if used must imitate PAINT specifically, not plaster or wood or Venetian. Also a precise composition constraint: unmounted art merges into a patterned wall. ASR poor to moderate; ar-deco garbled three different ways. No prices.
